# Test fixtures

Small real files for formats the test machine cannot create itself (test/samples.js).

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| sample.heic | made with an HEVC encoder for these tests |
| sample.rar | rar3-comment-plain.rar from markokr/rarfile tests (ISC); old solid RAR, opened with unar |
| sample-rar5.rar | rar5-solid.rar from markokr/rarfile tests (ISC); opened with bsdtar |
| sample.cab | test_read_format_cab_1.cab from libarchive tests (BSD-2-Clause) |
| sample.dng, sample.nef | DNG.dng and Nikon.nef from exiftool's t/images (Perl Artistic / GPL) |
| sample.numbers | test-1.numbers from masaccio/numbers-parser tests (MIT) |
